decision: how to tell a foreign holder
choice: N refusals in a row (LINEAR_WEBHOOK_REFUSED_LIMIT, default 3) count as "held by another owner"; no ss -ltnp on the PC
why: the loop already ends its own recorded ssh before each start, and the box account cannot see or signal the holder (ticket evidence); the listener probe already proves which listener answers when the tunnel is up

choice: linear-webhook-tunnel.held (PORT HOST) in the state dir; health reads it beside orch.db
why: the service script defaults ORCH_DB to the state dir orch.db; heartbeat rows only take allowlisted tokens, so a reason string cannot ride in them

choice: the tunnel loop stays up holding its lock but starts no ssh while the record names its port and host; start clears it, restart keeps it, another port or host drops it
why: ensure and cron see a running loop, so they stay quiet; self-heal restarts cannot loop

choice: heal skips a down tunnel whose reason is port held and escalates only on the pass that enters that state (compares the shared note() line with key.last)
why: the window-based escalation would alert every 30 minutes

choice: ~/.config/factory/linear-webhook.port, under LINEAR_WEBHOOK_PORT, over 8787; one PORT feeds serve --bind and both sides of -R
why: cron and profile ensure run with no env, so the env var alone is not a device setting; the Funnel on the PC is outside this repo (README: changes no network configuration)
